items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: But Heidi wasn’t really that hot in it.

ctx.x: Yeah. Duke Ellington, “Stompy Jones.” A great old piece.
All right. Well it’s been a really fun conversation. I see your daughter sings is that right?
Well she used to. She doesn’t anymore. She’s out of the business now. But she had a little shot at it and enjoyed it while it lasted. It got a little tough. There’s not that much work around.
